subject: CLOSE statement
notes: RE-VERDICTED (kb/Work PB893). GR5: 'the CLOSE statement for that file is completed and the EC-REPORT-NOT-TERMINATED exception condition is set to exist' - completion FIRST. EmitClose reads ReportWriter.IsActive for the file's associated reports BEFORE the close, then runs the close, its GR4 status update and the I-O USE hook, and only then raises the nonfatal EC and runs the declarative dispatch. The pre-PB893 shape raised before the close, so a declarative saw the pre-close status and a RESUME AT procedure-name (14.9.33.4 GR3) transferred out with the file still OPEN. pb893_close_report_completes pins it: after RESUME AT P2 the re-OPEN of the report file answers 00 (was 41), and the second declarative sees the updated status 00 (was 41). pb141_report_not_terminated pins CLOSE=00 with EXCEPTION-STATUS EC-REPORT-NOT-TERMINATED.
